preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access mint function

exploit_hint: As contract owner, call mint(address account, uint256 amount) to create tokens. The function incorrectly adds 'amount' to _tTotal (token supply) but also adds 'amount' to _rOwned[account] (reflection balance) without proper conversion. This corrupts the reflection rate (_rTotal/_tTotal). After minting, the attacker can transfer tokens and receive inflated values due to the corrupted rate, or exclude themselves and convert corrupted r-balances to t-balances for profit.
